label: Traces through one channel
subgoals: Subtract the pad diameter from the pitch
Subtract one space and divide by width plus space
Floor the quotient to get traces per channel

label: Rows per layer and layer count
section: Rows per layer and layer count
subgoals: Add one to the traces per channel
Divide the rows to escape by rows per layer
Round up to a whole number of layers

label: Balls escaped on the first layer
section: Balls escaped on the first layer
subgoals: Compute the escaped ring depth k
Subtract the inner square from the full array
Assign power and ground to the centre rings
